Only methods declared in sugar-navstack/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\NavStack

Breadcrumb final class

Renders a NavStack as a breadcrumb string.

MethodSummary
static new(): selfAdapted from KevM/bubbleo Breadcrumb — the upstream constructor takes the navstack model; this port's renderer is stack-free until render.
setSeparator(string $s): selfSet the string drawn between crumbs (and folded into each zone's click region except after the last crumb).
setTruncator(string $s): selfSet the elision marker shown in place of dropped leftmost crumbs.
setEmptyLabel(string $label): selfLabel painted when the stack is empty (NS-15).
setMaxWidth(int $w): selfHard cap on rendered cell width; 0 disables the cap.
setZonePrefix(string $prefix): selfRename the per-crumb zone id prefix (default crumb, ids crumb-{stackIndex}). Note that withScanner() CLONES the Scanner, so two breadcrumb widgets can never share one scanner instance; the prefix serves the reachable multi-widget shape instead — a host merging the zone enumerations (or one dispatch table) of several breadcrumbs, each with its own scanner, keeps crumb-2 unambiguous across the combined view.
setItemRenderer(\Closure $fn): selfCustom per-item renderer. The closure MUST return string|null: fn(NavigationItem $item, int $index, bool $focused): ?string. Return null to fall back to the default (sanitized) title rendering.
withScanner(?Scanner $scanner): selfAttach a Scanner for mouse-click hit-testing.
scanner(): ?ScannerThe scanner owned by this breadcrumb (as copied in by withScanner()), or null when click tracking is disabled.
scan(string $rendered, int $viewportWidth, int $row = 1): selfFeed a rendered breadcrumb string to the internal scanner so that subsequent hit-testing can determine which crumb zone contains a given coordinate pair.
hit(int $col, int $row): ?ZoneReturn the zone at the given ABSOLUTE terminal coordinate, or null if no crumb zone contains that cell.
hitItem(NavStack $stack, int $col, int $row): ?NavigationItemResolve an ABSOLUTE terminal coordinate straight to the stack item whose crumb zone contains it — the one-call click dispatcher.
visibleIndices(): arrayStack indices made visible by the most recent render (empty before the first render, and after a render of an empty stack). When setMaxWidth() elides older crumbs, these are the survivors' true positions — exactly the indices zone ids carry. Positions are meaningful ONLY for the stack that render() consumed — filtered() renumbers, and hitItem() refuses dispatches against a different stack or a since-mutated generation (NS-08).
setFocusedIndex(?int $index): selfMark which crumb the item renderer should style as selected (NS-16).
focusedIndex(): ?intThe focus the most recent render reflected: the raw intent when it survived into the visible set, otherwise null (NS-16). Renders without a stack (renderTitles(), empty renders) never carry focus.
elisionSpan(): ?arrayThe terminal cells the left-elision marker occupies on the CURRENT scanned render, as [start, end, row] (1-based, absolute — same coordinate space as hit()), or null when there is nothing to bind (NS-21).
render(NavStack $stack): stringRender the current navigation stack as a breadcrumb string.
renderTitles(array $titles): stringRender a custom list of titles (not from a NavStack).

Closable interface

Interface for navigation items that respond to enter/leave lifecycle events.

MethodSummary
onEnter(): voidCalled when this item becomes the current/active item.
onLeave(): voidCalled when this item is no longer the current item.
title(): stringReturns the item's title.

Escape final class

Separator escaping for navigation item titles.

MethodSummary
static title(string $title, string $separator = self::DEFAULT_SEPARATOR): stringEscape a title so it can safely appear in a breadcrumb render. If the title contains $separator, prefix each occurrence with a backslash.
static unescape(string $title, string $separator = self::DEFAULT_SEPARATOR): stringReverse title(). Pass the SAME $separator that was used to escape.

Lang final class

NavStack final class

Navigation stack — last-in, first-out navigation state.

MethodSummary
static new(): selfMirrors KevM/bubbleo NavStack (Go); the upstream constructor takes a window model (research §2.4) — this port's is dependency-free.
generation(): intThe mutation ledger of this exact stack object. Compare against the value a breadcrumb stamped at render time (see Breadcrumb::hitItem()'s cross-generation refusal); a fresh filtered() copy deliberately carries parent+1 so original/filtered confusion is caught on both axes (identity AND count).
push(string $title, mixed $data = null): selfPush a new navigation item onto the stack.
pop(): ?NavigationItemPop the topmost item off the stack and return it. Returns null if the stack is empty.
canPop(): boolCan the stack pop without going empty?
popTo(int $index): selfTruncate the stack to the item at $index (inclusive), removing everything newer. The item at position $index becomes the top.
popToRoot(): selfKeep ONLY the root item (spelled intent for what a negative popTo used to silently do — wipe the stack from a 1-based off-by-one). On an empty stack this is a no-op.
current(): ?NavigationItemPeek at the top item without removing it.
parent(): ?NavigationItemPeek at the item below the top.
depth(): intCurrent stack depth (number of items).
isEmpty(): boolIs the stack empty?
items(): arrayGet all items as a list.
updateTop(mixed $data): selfReplace the TOP ITEM: a fresh NavigationItem carrying the same title with new data (titles are readonly, so the item object itself is swapped — identity checks on the previous top stop matching). Does nothing if stack is empty.
clear(): selfClear the stack completely.
setItems(array $items): selfReplace all items at once (used by Shell for immutable operations).
static safeTitle(string $title): stringPUBLIC display facade for a raw title: the byte-identical sweep that view(), viewHtml(), Breadcrumb::render() and Breadcrumb::renderTitles() run every stack-sourced title through before emitting it. Hosts echoing an UNTRUSTED title outside those surfaces (a <title> tag, a log line, a custom renderer closure) call this instead of reaching into the internal sanitizer — or, worse, printing the raw accessor output.
view(string $separator = self::SEPARATOR): stringRender the navigation stack as a breadcrumb string. e.g. "Home › Settings › Display"
viewHtml(?callable $href = null, string $label = 'Breadcrumb', ?array $allowSchemes = null): stringRender the stack as semantic HTML breadcrumb.
filtered(string $term): selfFilter items by title or data matching $term (case-insensitive substring). Data is matched when it is scalar or Stringable, or — for array data such as ['route' => '/dash'] — when ANY scalar/Stringable value inside the array matches, at any depth (bounded: see MAX_PAYLOAD_DEPTH below). Returns a new NavStack with only matching items.
filter(string $term): self

NavigationItem final class

A single item on the navigation stack.

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly string $title, public readonly mixed $data = null)
onEnter(): voidContract default from Closable: a no-op. Nothing in this library dispatches it — a consumer that wires enter/leave events calls it, and subclasses are impossible (final); implement Closable on your own type instead.
onLeave(): voidContract default from Closable: a no-op. See onEnter() for who dispatches.
title(): stringReturns the item's title.

Shell final class

Shell — combines NavStack + Breadcrumb into a single navigation component.

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly NavStack $stack, public readonly Breadcrumb $breadcrumb)
static new(?Breadcrumb $breadcrumb = null): self
withPush(string $title, mixed $data = null): selfPush a new navigation item and return a new Shell.
withPop(): selfPop the top item and return a new Shell.
withPopTo(int $index): selfTruncate the stack to the item at $index (inclusive), removing newer items, and return a new Shell. A negative $index THROWS (see NavStack::popTo()); NavStack::popToRoot() names the keep-only-the-root intent the old silent clamp used to swallow.
withBreadcrumb(Breadcrumb $breadcrumb): self
renderBreadcrumb(): string
withDirectory(string $path): selfParse a directory path and push each segment as a navigation item. e.g. "/home/user/projects" pushes "home", then "user", then "projects" Each segment's data is the full path up to that segment.
pushDirectory(string $path): self

Url final class

URL/path derivation utilities for navigation stacks.

MethodSummary
static derive(NavStack $stack): stringDerive a URL path string from the navigation stack. e.g. NavStack with items ["home", "settings", "display"] → "/home/settings/display"
static deriveTo(NavStack $stack, int $index): stringDerive the ancestor-prefix path up to AND INCLUDING stack index $index: the first $index+1 crumbs of derive()'s output.
static parse(string $path): NavStackParse a URL path back into a NavStack.
